name: Golden Dew Barrier Serum
description: A cushiony daily serum that layers multi-weight hyaluronic acid, beta-glucan and ceramides for lasting, comfortable hydration.
applications: Use 2–3 drops after cleansing, morning and evening. Press into damp skin before moisturizer.

name: Cloud Veil Ceramide Cream
description: A plush but breathable moisturizer that seals in hydration without a heavy finish, leaving skin soft and quietly luminous.
applications: Massage a pearl-sized amount over face and neck as the final step of your skincare routine.

name: Pearl Light Milky Essence
description: A lightweight milky essence with niacinamide and rice ferment to visibly refine texture and restore a fresh, translucent glow.
applications: Pat one to two layers into clean skin before serum. Use daily, morning or evening.

name: Petal Satin Lip Color
description: A creamy, buildable lipstick with true satin luminosity and a soft-focus finish in an edited range of modern neutrals.
applications: Swipe directly onto lips for full color or tap with a fingertip for a diffused petal stain.

name: Soft Bloom Powder Blush
description: A finely milled blush that melts into skin with seamless, softly radiant color and no visible powderiness.
applications: Sweep across the high points of cheeks and blend upward. Layer slowly for a watercolor flush.

name: Second Skin Luminous Tint
description: Flexible light-to-medium coverage that evens tone while preserving the dimensional finish of real skin.
applications: Shake well, then blend one pump from the center of the face outward with fingers, sponge or brush.

name: Quiet Bloom Eau de Parfum
description: A skin-close floral where pear blossom and iris settle into creamy sandalwood and clean amber.
applications: Mist onto pulse points and allow the fragrance to warm naturally on skin. Do not rub.

name: Amber Silk Body Ritual
description: A sensorial pairing of replenishing body cream and botanical oil, scented with warm amber, neroli and soft woods.
applications: Massage cream over dry skin, then press a few drops of oil onto shoulders, arms and legs for a satin sheen.
